headword: {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}

definitions.explanation: a method of selling goods or services where orders are placed remotely, by mail, phone, internet, or other means, without face-to-face interaction

examples.japanese: {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a book through mail order.

examples.japanese: {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利用者|りようしゃ}→利用者：03189_riyousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of mail-order customers is increasing year by year.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通信販売|つうしんはんばい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{展開|てんかい}している→展開する：25229_tenkaisuru⟧。
examples.english: This company is developing its business primarily through mail-order sales.

notes:
A formal compound of ⟦{通信|つうしん}→通信：03514_tsuushin⟧ (communication) and ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (sales). This is the official, legal term for any form of remote commerce. Often abbreviated to ⟦{通販|つうはん}→通販：17464_tsuuhan⟧ in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy through mail order
- {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: mail-order business
- {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧: the Act on Specified Commercial Transactions (governing distance selling)

FORMS:
⟦{通販|つうはん}→通販：17464_tsuuhan⟧ is the widely used shortened form and is much more common in daily conversation. The full form {通信販売|つうしんはんばい} appears in official, legal, and business contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{通販|つうはん}→通販：17464_tsuuhan⟧: mail order (abbreviation) — the everyday short form
- ⟦ネット{通販|つうはん}→ネット通販：22847_nettotsuuhan⟧: online shopping — specifically internet-based
- {店頭販売|てんとうはんばい}: over-the-counter sales — selling at a physical store
